series: IDC FutureScape: Worldwide IT Industry Predictions; IDC FutureScape: Worldwide CIO Agenda Predictions

futurescapes.name: Worldwide IT Industry
futurescapes.title: IDC FutureScape: Worldwide IT Industry 2017 Predictions
futurescapes.note: IDC document number not found, so the table of contents could not be read. Forbes (the one known full list) returns 403 and has no Internet Archive copy. InformationWeek (November 2016) paraphrases the ten predictions; paraphrases are not captured as quotes.

futurescapes.name: Worldwide CIO Agenda
futurescapes.title: IDC FutureScape: Worldwide CIO Agenda 2017 Predictions
futurescapes.note: Table of contents read from an Internet Archive copy.

entries.quote: By 2019, 40% of IT Projects Will Create New Digital Services and Revenue Streams That Monetize Data
entries.subject: IT projects monetizing data
entries.metric: share of IT projects creating digital services and revenue streams that monetize data

entries.quote: By 2018, 65% of IT Organizations Will Create New Customer-Facing and Ecosystem-Facing Services to Meet the Business DX Needs
entries.subject: Customer- and ecosystem-facing IT services
entries.metric: share of IT organizations creating customer- and ecosystem-facing services

entries.quote: Lack of Vision, Credibility, or Ability to Influence Will Keep 40% of CIOs from Attaining Leadership Roles in Enterprise DX by 2017
entries.subject: CIO leadership in digital transformation
entries.metric: share of CIOs kept from DX leadership roles

entries.quote: By 2019, 75% of CIOs Will Recognize the Limitations of Traditional IT and Embrace a Leadership Approach That Embodies a Virtuous Cycle of Innovation (Leading in 3D)
entries.subject: Leading in 3D
entries.metric: share of CIOs embracing an innovation-cycle leadership approach

entries.quote: 40% of CIOs Will Advance DX Initiatives by Building Organizational Linkages with LOB Technology Teams and Across IT Organizational Silos, Empowering Changes in Thinking, Culture, and Practices by 2018
entries.subject: IT and LOB technology team linkages
entries.metric: share of CIOs advancing DX through links with LOB technology teams

entries.quote: By 2019, 80% of Bimodal IT Organizations Will Accumulate a Crippling Technical Debt, Resulting in Spiraling Complexity, Costs, and Lost Credibility
entries.subject: Bimodal IT technical debt
entries.metric: share of bimodal IT organizations accumulating crippling technical debt

entries.quote: 45% of CIOs Will Shift Primary Focus from Physical to Digital and Move Away from BPM and Optimization by 2018 to Deliver Scale, Predictability, and Speed
entries.subject: Physical to digital focus
entries.metric: share of CIOs shifting primary focus from physical to digital

entries.quote: By 2018, 45% of CIOs Will Focus on Platformization, Using DevOps for Rapid Development, Cost Reduction, and Enterprise Agility
entries.subject: Platformization and DevOps
entries.metric: share of CIOs focusing on platformization with DevOps

entries.quote: By 2019, 70% of IT Organizations Will Shift Their Culture to a Start-Up-Like Work Environment by Embracing Agile Practices and Open Source Communities
entries.subject: Start-up-like IT culture
entries.metric: share of IT organizations shifting to a start-up-like culture

entries.quote: By 2017, 80% of CIOs Will Help Drive Global Risk Portfolios That Enable Adaptive Responses to Security, Compliance, Business, or Catastrophic Threats
entries.subject: Global risk portfolios
entries.metric: share of CIOs helping drive global risk portfolios

notes: CIO Agenda complete; IT Industry list not found.
